item.title: Nara National Museum: Masterpieces of Buddhist Art — Guide
item.description: The Nara National Museum, set within Nara Park, is Japan’s premier museum of Buddhist art, its elegant Meiji-era Main Building and modern galleries housing a superb permanent collection of Buddhist statues, paintings, sutras and ritual objects spanning centuries. Its most famous event is the annual Shosoin Exhibition each autumn, when a rotating selection of the fabled 8th-century treasures of the Shosoin — the imperial repository at Todaiji, holding artifacts from along the Silk Road — goes on rare public display, drawing visitors from across the country.
